exposure: Sacral neuromodulation for lower-urinary tract symptoms
cohort: 21 women who had received sacral neuromodulation for lower-urinary tract symptoms and subsequently became pregnant
finding: Pregnancy during sacral neuromodulation for lower-urinary tract symptoms did not lead to adverse fetal outcomes, but some women experienced complications like urinary infections and decreased device effectiveness postpartum.
mod_finding: Four out of the 24 live births were delivered via cesarean section.
